title: feat(toolbar): multi-line list toggle for ordered/unordered lists

commits.message:
feat(toolbar): multi-line list toggle for ordered/unordered lists

Extend toggleOrderedList and toggleUnorderedList to support multi-line
selections. When multiple lines are selected:
- If all lines already have the target list prefix, remove it from all.
- Otherwise, add the prefix to every line (replacing any existing list marker).

Single-line (cursor-only) behaviour is preserved unchanged.

Closes ROADMAP #1

test(toolbar): add multi-line list toggle tests

Covers: add/remove OL/UL markers on multi-line selections, UL-to-OL
conversion, OL-to-UL conversion, and single-line fallback.

refactor(toolbar): extract shared toggleList helper, add multi-line blockquote

- Extract toggleList() to eliminate duplication between OL/UL toggle
- getSelectedLines() now starts from selection instead of pos 0
- toggleBlockquote() now supports multi-line selections
- All 311 tests pass

test(toolbar): add edge-case tests for multi-line toggle

- Mixed OL/UL/plain lines
- Selection starting mid-line
- Multi-line blockquote add/remove
- Fix off-by-one in selection range
